description: A biochemical reaction is a directly listed component of a Reactome pathway. Membership is recorded for each pathway that directly contains the reaction; ancestor pathway memberships are not asserted.

common_properties.name: sources
common_properties.description: Data sources contributing this relationship; Reactome.

common_properties.name: version
common_properties.description: Reactome release number in which this relationship was last seen.

common_properties.name: last_updated
common_properties.description: Time this relationship was created or last updated in SPOKE.

source_contributions.scope: Biochemical reactions directly contained in pathways within the human Reactome BioPAX hierarchies rooted at R-HSA-162582 (Signaling Pathways, historically Signal Transduction), R-HSA-168256 (Immune System), and R-HSA-5663202 (Diseases of signal transduction by growth factor receptors and second messengers), including their descendant pathways. Memberships in out-of-scope pathways are excluded.
source_contributions.description: Direct reaction membership follows Reactome pathway components. Degradation and TemplateReaction events are excluded.
